targetReport.description: NBS's annual pocket compendium (国家统计局 编, 中国统计出版社 出版), the concise companion to the China Statistical Yearbook: a comprehensive digest of the previous year's main economic and social indicators with headline historical series since 1978, released each May — some four months before the Yearbook — across general, population, national accounts, employment and wages, prices, living standards, fiscal, resources and energy, investment, trade, agriculture, industry, construction, retail and tourism, transport, finance, science and education, health, culture, and the Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and international appendices. Because it is the earliest official source of national and all-province comparison figures, provincial and city yearbooks reprint their 'national share' and 'all provinces' appendices from it and name it by title with the edition year (Shandong ch23, Jiangsu ch21, Hubei appendix, Yunnan table 1-6, Nanjing table 1-15, Guangdong appendix). The cited page is the 2022 edition's entry on NBS's own 统计出版物 listing (/zs/tjwh/tjkw/tjzl/), which records compiler, publisher, ISBN, date and contents; the listing's newest Abstract entry is 2022, so the 2024 and 2025 editions the yearbooks cite have no NBS page of their own yet — one node for the annual publication, as with cn-statistical-yearbook, and a dated citation reaches it. Minted round 42 after being named by six yearbooks across rounds 29-42.
targetReport.cadence_note: Annual, published each May for the preceding year.
